mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP growth rate indicates a robust economy, leading to higher consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances with strong GDP growth, or the correlation between GDP growth and S&P 500 returns is not significant (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances with high federal funds rates, or the correlation between federal funds rates and S&P 500 returns is not significant (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% indicates a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances with low unemployment rates, or the correlation between unemployment rates and S&P 500 returns is not significant (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production indicates a strong supply chain, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances with strong industrial production growth, or the correlation between industrial production and S&P 500 returns is not significant (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in GDP growth rate and consumer spending indicates a robust economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances with strong GDP growth and consumer spending, or the correlation between GDP growth and S&P 500 returns is not significant (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate below 2.5% and an increase in the money supply indicate an easing monetary cycle, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances with low federal funds rates and high money supply growth, or the correlation between federal funds rates and S&P 500 returns is not significant (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A joint decline in the unemployment rate and an increase in payroll employment indicate a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances with low unemployment rates and high payroll employment growth, or the correlation between unemployment rates and S&P 500 returns is not significant (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts indicates a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances with low housing starts, or the correlation between housing starts and S&P 500 returns is not significant (p > 0.1).
